## Easy on the eye

**Word Power 61 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Pleasant to look at.

### Usage

1. Her paintings are very easy on the eye.
2. I like your colour scheme in this room. It's easy on the eye.

### Your turn

Use “easy on the eye” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
